title: urdfImport.ReduceURDFrobotData: locked joints and removed links of URDF robot data
author: Claude-JG
description: The import has no way to leave out links such as the fingers of the Panda. Decided: ReduceURDFrobotData(robotData, lockedJoints, removedLinks) on the data of GetURDFrobotData, a locked link merged into its parent with its mass, center of mass and inertia; design robotics.md section 3.5(a).
releaseNotes: urdfImport.ReduceURDFrobotData leaves out joints and links in the data of GetURDFrobotData: a locked joint merges its link into the link above with its mass, center of mass and inertia, a removed link goes with all links below it.
